title_zh: 2026年拉萨社保服务提质增效惠民生
title_en: Lhasa Boosts Social Security Services to Benefit Residents in 2026
summary_zh: 2026年10月，拉萨市推进社保服务提质增效惠民生，市委书记达娃次仁主持市委理论学习中心组学习会，代理市长李修武主持全市高质量发展务虚会。
summary_en: In October 2026, Lhasa moved to improve social security services for residents, as Municipal Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired a Party committee study session and acting mayor Li Xiuwu led a high-quality development meeting.
